failures.what: table caption used the kit's sr-only pattern (as in the kit's Hours); the gate reads a 1px sr-only box as overflowing and clipped text. Fixed by making the caption visible: the section header or the group heading sits inside the caption.

wanted: The browser gate flags any sr-only element with text as overflowing; the kit's own Hours caption would fail the same way. The gate should skip visually hidden elements.

The gate's stylesheet only picks up classes written literally, so Heading's type-h2/type-display and Text's type-lead are missing in the browser check: headlines and subheads render at body size there.
A kit duration formatter (210 minutes as '3 h 30 min'); blocks use Intl unit 'minute' for now.
Localised UI words: table headers 'Service', 'Item' and 'Price' are English on every site, including the Arabic test case.
Heading can only make an h2 at h2 style; a price list placed first on a page cannot take h1 without display size.
notes: Table variant is one real table that stacks on phones (container query below @md) with a visible level label per price, and becomes a table with a sticky name column inside a scroll area from @md. Separate tables per group, so column widths can differ slightly between groups on wide screens.
